title: Nixon sets up Operation 40 after Castro refuses his terms

tellings.quote: And so he then set up this covert operation, which was called originally operation 40.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a researcher, told podcast host Jesse Michels that around 1959 and 1960, after Fidel Castro, Cuba's new leader, refused Richard Nixon's terms, Nixon set up a secret operation first called Operation 40. Sheehan tells it as part of a wider story linking hidden government operations to the killing of President John F. Kennedy and to UFO secrecy.
